source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 10 exercise hal (PDF 240-243): MCQs jawab aur wajah ke saath, short, descriptive aur numerical sawalon ke model jawab, Kitab ki ghalti aur Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 10 (Electrochemistry) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab aur numericals step by step hal kiye gaye hain. Diagram wale sawal (Zn-Cu cell, SHE) lafzon mein bayan kiye gaye hain. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
I. The activity series of metals arranges metals in order of their:
(Metals ki activity series metals ko kis cheez ki tarteeb mein rakhti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Activity series metals ko electrons khone (oxidation) ke rujhan ke mutabiq tarteeb deti hai; oopar wale metals ka E° sab se zyada negative hai aur woh sab se asaani se oxidize hote hain (10.20).

blocks.prompt:
II. According to the activity series, which of the following metals would most readily displace hydrogen gas from dilute acids?
(Activity series ke mutabiq kaun sa metal dilute acids se hydrogen gas sab se asaani se nikalega?)
blocks.explanation: Mg series mein bohat oopar hai (E° = −2.37 V), hydrogen se kaafi oopar; Cu, Ag aur Pt hydrogen se neeche hain (positive E°) aur hydrogen nahi nikalte (10.20).

blocks.prompt:
III. The salt bridge allows transfer of ------------ in Zn-Cu voltaic cell.
(Zn-Cu voltaic cell mein salt bridge kis ki muntaqili (transfer) hone deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Salt bridge dono half-cells ke darmiyan ions ki harkat se circuit poora karta hai (cations cathode ki taraf, anions anode ki taraf), taake ionic balance qaim rahe; electrons is mein se nahi guzarte (10.15). Murad jawab 'dono' (positive aur negative ions) hai; Kitab ki ghalti dekhein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Chhapa hua koi option bilkul durust nahi. Zn-Cu cell mein salt bridge (maslan KNO₃ mein bheega filter paper, 10.15) apne hi electrolyte ke ions chalata hai: anions (NO₃⁻) zinc wale half-cell ki taraf aur cations (K⁺) copper wale half-cell ki taraf, taake dono solutions neutral rahein. Khud Zn²⁺ aur SO₄²⁻ is mein se paar nahi jate, aur electrons kabhi nahi guzarte. Is liye (a), (b) aur (c) lafzan sahi nahi, aur (d) "None of these" bhi kaha ja sakta hai. (c) "Both" kitab ka murad jawab maan kar rakha gaya: salt bridge positive aur negative dono qism ke ions ko chalne deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
IV. If Zn-Cu galvanic cell works ideally after complete discharge, both compartments will have:
(Agar Zn-Cu galvanic cell mukammal discharge ho jaye to dono hisson mein kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Discharge ke dauran Zn → Zn²⁺ + 2e⁻ aur Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Cu. Mukammal discharge par saare Cu²⁺ khatam ho jate hain aur Zn²⁺ ban chuke hote hain, is liye solutions mein ZnSO₄ (Zn²⁺ aur SO₄²⁻) reh jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
V. Which of the following half-reactions represents a reduction process?
(Kaun si half-reaction reduction ko zahir karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Reduction electrons lena hai (10.1). (c) mein Cl₂ electrons leta hai (0 → −1). (a) aur (b) oxidation hain (electrons khote hain).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Do options durust hain: (c) Cl₂ + 2e⁻ → 2Cl⁻ aur (d) 2H⁺ + 2e⁻ → H₂ dono mein electrons liye ja rahe hain, is liye dono reduction hain; (a) aur (b) mein electrons khoye jate hain (oxidation). (c) sirf do sahi options mein pehla hone ki wajah se diya gaya hai; (d) bhi utna hi sahi hai aur us ke bhi poore number milne chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
f. Which of the following half-reactions represents the oxidation process occurring in the disproportionation of Cu+?
(Cu⁺ ki disproportionation mein hone wala oxidation kaun si half-reaction hai?)
blocks.explanation: 2Cu⁺ → Cu²⁺ + Cu mein aik Cu⁺ oxidize hota hai (+1 → +2, aik electron khota hai) aur doosra reduce (+1 → 0). Oxidation wala hissa Cu⁺ → Cu²⁺ + e⁻ hai (10.3). (b) reduction wala hissa aur (d) poori reaction hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Is item par 'f.' chhapa hai; Q.1 ki numbering mein yeh VI hai.

blocks.prompt:
VII. If salt bridge is not used between two half cells in a Galvanic cell, then the voltage
(Agar galvanic cell ke do half-cells ke darmiyan salt bridge na ho to voltage:)
blocks.explanation: Salt bridge ke baghair circuit poora nahi hota: ions solutions ko neutral rakhne ke liye harkat nahi kar sakte, current nahi chalta aur voltage zero ho jata hai (10.15).

blocks.prompt:
VIII. In an electrolysis experiment, if a charge of 96,500 Coulombs is passed through a solution, the amount of substance liberated or deposited at the electrode is directly related to:
(Electrolysis mein 96,500 C charge guzarne se electrode par nikalne ya jamne wali cheez ki miqdar kis se seedha mutalliq hai?)

options.text: Avogadro number ke barabar ions ka discharge
Metal ion ka standard electrode potential

blocks.explanation: 96,500 C aik Faraday hai, yani aik mole electrons ka charge (10.8). Yeh aik charge wale ion ka 1 mole nikalta hai lekin Cu²⁺ ka sirf ½ mole, is liye (c) hamesha sahi nahi.

blocks.prompt:
IX. The experimental determination of Avogadro’s number through electrolysis typically involves measuring:
(Electrolysis se Avogadro number maloom karne ke tajurbe mein aam tor par kya naapa jata hai?)

options.text: Maloom charge se jamne ya nikalne wali cheez ka mass
Electrolysis ke dauran temperature ki tabdeeli

blocks.explanation: Constant current maloom waqt tak guzar kar copper anode ka wazan pehle aur baad mein liya jata hai; Q = I × t aur kam hone wale mass se aik mole electrons ka charge nikal kar aik electron ke charge se taqseem kiya jata hai (10.10).

blocks.prompt:
X. The principle of measuring DO by Wrinkler’s Method is based on
(Winkler method se DO naapne ka usool kis par mabni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ghuli hui oxygen KI ko iodine mein badalti hai, aur nikalne wali iodine ko starch ke saath sodium thiosulfate se titrate kiya jata hai (10.27). Nikalne wali iodine ki titration iodometry hai (iodimetry seedhi iodine solution se titration hai; yeh lafz chapter se bahar hai).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: 'Wrinkler’s Method' ghalat chhapa hai; sahi naam Winkler’s method hai, jaisa chapter mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
XI. A positive value for the standard electrode potential (E°) of a metal ion/metal half-cell (e.g., Cu²⁺/Cu) indicates that:
(Metal ion/metal half-cell (misal Cu²⁺/Cu) ka positive E° kya batata hai?)

options.text: Metal ion asaani se oxidize hota hai
Metal ion asaani se reduce hota hai
Metal dilute acids se asaani se hydrogen nikalega

blocks.explanation: Zyada positive E° ka matlab reduction (Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Cu) ka zyada rujhan; Cu²⁺ ions asaani se reduce hote hain (10.11, 10.17.2). Aise metals hydrogen se neeche hain aur hydrogen nahi nikalte.

blocks.prompt:
XII. Which of the following changes would typically lead to an increase in the rate of electrolysis?
(Kaun si tabdeeli electrolysis ki raftaar barhati hai?)

options.text: Electrodes ka surface area kam karna
Cell mein guzarne wala current barhana

blocks.explanation: Banne wala mass charge Q = I × t ke mutanasib hai (10.8); zyada current har second zyada cheez jamata hai. Baqi teeno tabdeeliyan current kam karti hain.

blocks.prompt:
a. How and why electrical double layer is formed?
Electrical double layer kaise aur kyun banti hai?
blocks.explanation: Zinc ko Zn²⁺ ions ke solution mein rakhne par kuch Zn atoms Zn²⁺ ban kar solution mein chale jate hain aur metal ki satah par zaid electrons chhor jate hain. Yeh negative satah solution ke Zn²⁺ ions ko apni taraf kheenchti hai jo us ke qareeb qatar bana lete hain. Metal par negative charge aur saath positive ions ki yeh do tehen electrical double layer hai; is se metal aur solution ke darmiyan potential paida hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
b. Why electrode potential of Cu is called reduction potential?
Cu ka electrode potential reduction potential kyun kehlata hai?
blocks.explanation: Electrode potential reduction half-reaction ke liye likha jata hai: Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Cu, E° = +0.34 V. Is ki positive qeemat batati hai ke Cu²⁺ ions H⁺ se zyada asaani se reduce hote hain; SHE se jorne par copper positive terminal hota hai jahan reduction hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
c. What are the advantages of salt bridge in a galvanic cell?
Galvanic cell mein salt bridge ke kya fayde hain?
blocks.explanation:
1. Dono half-cells ke darmiyan electrical circuit poora karta hai.
2. Ions ko harkat karne deta hai taake har solution electrically neutral rahe (ionic balance).
3. Dono solutions ko seedha milne nahi deta, is liye cell chalta rehta hai; is ke baghair voltage zero ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
d. How can we predict the feasibility of a chemical reaction using the cell voltage?
Cell voltage se chemical reaction ke mumkin (feasible) hone ka andaza kaise lagate hain?
blocks.explanation:
Dono half-reactions likh kar E°cell = E°(reduction wala hissa) − E°(oxidation wala hissa) nikalein. E°cell positive ho to reaction mumkin (feasible) hai; negative ho to nahi.
Misal: Zn + Cu²⁺ → Zn²⁺ + Cu: E°cell = +0.34 − (−0.76) = +1.10 V, mumkin; ulti reaction (Cu + Zn²⁺) −1.10 V, na-mumkin.

blocks.prompt:
e. During electrolysis of aqueous NaCl, why Na is not liberated at the cathode?
Aqueous NaCl ki electrolysis mein cathode par Na kyun nahi nikalta?
blocks.explanation: Na⁺ ka E° bohat negative (−2.71 V) hai, is liye ise reduce karna bohat mushkil hai. Pani ke hydrogen ions kahin zyada asaani se reduce hote hain, is liye cathode par H₂ gas nikalti hai (2H⁺ + 2e⁻ → H₂) aur Na⁺ solution mein (NaOH ki soorat) reh jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
f. Calculate the Ox. No. of chromium (Cr) in the following compounds:
(i) CrCl₃ (ii) Cr₂(SO₄)₃ (iii) Cr₂O₇²⁻
In mein chromium ka oxidation number hisaab karein.
blocks.explanation:
(i) CrCl₃: Cr + 3(−1) = 0, is liye Cr = +3
(ii) Cr₂(SO₄)₃: 2Cr + 3(−2) = 0 (SO₄²⁻ = −2), is liye Cr = +3
(iii) Cr₂O₇²⁻: 2Cr + 7(−2) = −2, 2Cr = +12, is liye Cr = +6

blocks.prompt:
g. The order of decreasing reactivity of metals based on their position is K > Mg > Zn > Fe > Cu. Write balanced chemical equations for the reactions that would occur (if any) when:
i) Copper is added to a solution of magnesium sulfate.
ii) Iron is added to a dilute solution of hydrochloric acid.
K > Mg > Zn > Fe > Cu ki tarteeb ke mutabiq reactions (agar hon) ki balanced equations likhein.
blocks.explanation:
i) Cu(s) + MgSO₄(aq) → koi reaction nahi. Cu series mein Mg se neeche hai, is liye Mg ko nahi hata sakta.
ii) Fe(s) + 2HCl(aq) → FeCl₂(aq) + H₂(g). Fe hydrogen se oopar hai, is liye acid se hydrogen nikal deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
h. Explain why some metals higher in the activity series can displace hydrogen from acids, while others lower in the series cannot.
Activity series mein oopar wale kuch metals acids se hydrogen kyun nikalte hain aur neeche wale kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen se oopar wale metals ka E° negative hai; yeh H₂ se zyada asaani se electrons khote hain aur H⁺ ko H₂ mein badal dete hain (misal Mg + 2H⁺ → Mg²⁺ + H₂, E°cell positive). Hydrogen se neeche wale metals (Cu, Ag, Au) ka E° positive hai; yeh H⁺ ko electrons nahi de sakte kyunke E°cell negative hoga.

blocks.prompt:
i. Calculate Number of Faradays required to deposit 108 g of Ag¹⁺, 63.5 g of Cu²⁺ and 27 g of Al³⁺.
108 g Ag, 63.5 g Cu aur 27 g Al jamane ke liye kitne Faraday chahiye?
blocks.explanation:
1 Faraday = aik mole electrons ka charge; Faradays ki tadaad = liye gaye electrons ke moles.
Ag: 108 g = 1 mol; Ag⁺ + e⁻ → Ag; 1 mol e⁻ = 1 F
Cu: 63.5 g = 1 mol; Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Cu; 2 mol e⁻ = 2 F
Al: 27 g = 1 mol; Al³⁺ + 3e⁻ → Al; 3 mol e⁻ = 3 F
(Teeno jamane hon to kul 6 F.)

blocks.prompt:
j. In an electrolysis experiment, a current of 0.500 A was passed through a solution of AgNO₃ for 30.0 minutes. The mass of silver deposited on the cathode was found to be 0.503 g. Given that the molar mass of silver is 107.87 g mol⁻¹ and the charge on a silver ion is +1. Calculate the value of Avogadro’s number (NA) from this data.
0.500 A current 30.0 minute tak AgNO₃ mein guzara gaya aur 0.503 g silver jama hua. Is data se Avogadro number nikalein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: I = 0.500 A, t = 30.0 min = 1800 s, m(Ag) = 0.503 g, M = 107.87 g mol⁻¹, aik electron ka charge e = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C (10.10)
Q = I × t = 0.500 A × 1800 s = 900 C
Ag ke moles = 0.503 g / 107.87 g mol⁻¹ = 4.663 × 10⁻³ mol
Ag⁺ + e⁻ → Ag, is liye electrons ke moles = 4.663 × 10⁻³ mol
Aik mole electrons ka charge = 900 C / 4.663 × 10⁻³ mol = 1.930 × 10⁵ C mol⁻¹
NA = 1.930 × 10⁵ C mol⁻¹ / 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C = 1.21 × 10²⁴ mol⁻¹
Yeh asal qeemat 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹ ka dugna hai kyunke kitab ka data aapas mein mel nahi khata (Kitab ki ghalti box dekhein).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ka data aapas mein mel nahi khata. 900 C (0.500 A, 30.0 min) se 900/96500 × 107.87 = 1.006 g silver jamna chahiye, 0.503 g nahi; is data se NA = 1.21 × 10²⁴ mol⁻¹ aata hai. 0.503 g 15.0 minute (450 C) ke mutabiq hai: tab aik mole electrons ka charge = 450 C / 4.663 × 10⁻³ mol = 9.65 × 10⁴ C mol⁻¹ aur NA = 9.65 × 10⁴ / 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ = 6.03 × 10²³ mol⁻¹.

blocks.prompt:
k. A cell is set up with a standard nickel electrode (Ni²⁺(aq) + 2e⁻ ⇌ Ni(s) E⁰ = −0.25 V) and a standard cobalt electrode (Co²⁺(aq) + 2e⁻ ⇌ Co(s), E⁰ = −0.28 V).
i) Identify which metal will be the anode and which will be the cathode. Justify your answer.
ii) Write the balanced overall cell reaction.
iii) Calculate the standard cell potential (E°cell).
Nickel aur cobalt electrodes se bane cell mein anode aur cathode pehchanein, cell reaction likhein aur E°cell nikalein.
blocks.explanation:
i) Cobalt anode hai: is ka E⁰ (−0.28 V) zyada negative hai, is liye Co asaani se electrons khota hai (oxidation). Nickel, kam negative E⁰ (−0.25 V) wala, cathode hai (reduction).
ii) Co(s) + Ni²⁺(aq) → Co²⁺(aq) + Ni(s)
iii) E°cell = E°(cathode) − E°(anode) = (−0.25 V) − (−0.28 V) = +0.03 V

blocks.prompt:
Q.3. How electrode potential varies with concentration of an aqueous solution? Use the NERST equation to explain this variation.
Electrode potential solution ke concentration ke saath kaise badalta hai? Nernst equation se samjhayein.
blocks.explanation:
Concentration ka asar (Le Chatelier ka usool): Mⁿ⁺(aq) + ne⁻ ⇌ M(s) mein [Mⁿ⁺] barhane se equilibrium daayein taraf jata hai, is liye E zyada positive (kam negative) hota hai; [Mⁿ⁺] kam karne se E zyada negative hota hai.
Misal: Zn²⁺ + 2e⁻ ⇌ Zn, E° = −0.76 V: [Zn²⁺] > 1.00 mol dm⁻³ par E kam negative; [Zn²⁺] < 1.00 mol dm⁻³ par E zyada negative. Fe³⁺ + e⁻ ⇌ Fe²⁺ (E° = +0.77 V) mein zyada Fe³⁺ se E zyada positive aur zyada Fe²⁺ se kam positive (Table 10.1).
Nernst equation: E = E° + (RT/zF) ln([oxidized form]/[reduced form])
R = 8.314 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹, T kelvin mein, z = muntaqil electrons, F = 96500 C mol⁻¹. ln x = 2.303 log x aur T = 298 K lene se:
E = E° + (0.059/z) log([oxidized form]/[reduced form])
Metal electrode ke liye [M] = 1, is liye E = E° + (0.059/z) log[Mⁿ⁺].
Misal: 0.1 M Zn²⁺ mein Zn: E = −0.76 + (0.059/2) log 0.1 = −0.76 − 0.03 = −0.79 V, E° se zyada negative, jaisa andaza tha.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: 'NERST equation' ghalat chhapa hai; sahi naam Nernst equation hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q.4. How Avogadro’s number can be derived using an electrolytic cell?
Electrolytic cell se Avogadro number kaise nikala jata hai?
blocks.explanation:
Usool: L = aik mole electrons ka charge / aik electron ka charge (1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C).
Tareeqa: khalis copper anode aur cathode ka wazan karein; copper(II) sulfate solution ko constant current (variable resistor se taqreeban 0.2 A, ammeter par) se maloom waqt tak electrolyse karein; electrodes ko distilled water aur propanone se dho kar sukhayein aur dobara wazan karein. Anode ke mass ki kami istemal hoti hai (copper cathode par hamesha theek nahi chipakta).
Misali nataij: I = 0.20 A, t = 34 min; anode 56.53 g → 56.40 g, yani 0.13 g Cu nikla.
Q = I × t = 0.20 × 34 × 60 = 408 C
1 mol Cu (63.5 g) ka charge = (408 / 0.13) × 63.5 = 199292 C
Cu → Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻: 1 mol Cu ke liye 2 mol electrons
Aik mole electrons ka charge = 199292 / 2 = 99646 C
L = 99646 C / 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C = 6.2 × 10²³ mol⁻¹, asal qeemat 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹ ke qareeb.

blocks.prompt:
Q.5. Describe the construction and working principle of the Zn-Cu Galvanic cell.
Zn-Cu galvanic cell ki banawat (construction) aur kaam ka usool bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Banawat (diagram lafzon mein):
1. Baayan half-cell: zinc ki rod 1.00 mol dm⁻³ ZnSO₄ solution mein (Zn²⁺/Zn).
2. Daayan half-cell: khalis copper rod 1.00 mol dm⁻³ CuSO₄ solution mein (Cu²⁺/Cu), 25 °C par.
3. Dono rods taaron se high-resistance voltmeter ke zariye jure hain.
4. Salt bridge (saturated KNO₃ mein bheega filter paper) dono solutions mein dooba hai.
Labels: zinc = anode (−), copper = cathode (+), taar mein electrons Zn se Cu ki taraf.
Kaam: cell khud-ba-khud (spontaneous) redox reaction ki chemical energy ko electrical energy mein badalta hai.
Anode (oxidation): Zn(s) → Zn²⁺(aq) + 2e⁻
Cathode (reduction): Cu²⁺(aq) + 2e⁻ → Cu(s)
Kul reaction: Zn(s) + Cu²⁺(aq) → Zn²⁺(aq) + Cu(s)
Electrons bahar ki taar mein zinc se copper ki taraf jate hain; salt bridge mein ions chal kar dono solutions ko neutral rakhte hain. Zinc rod aahista ghulti hai aur copper rod par copper jamta hai.
E°cell = E°(cathode) − E°(anode) = +0.34 − (−0.76) = +1.10 V

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: 'An Ox, Red Cat' - Anode par Oxidation, Cathode par Reduction. Galvanic cell mein anode negative aur cathode positive hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q.6 What is meant by Standard Hydrogen Electrode (SHE)? How it is used to measure the electrode potential of another electrode?
Standard Hydrogen Electrode (SHE) kya hai? Is se kisi doosre electrode ka electrode potential kaise naapa jata hai?
blocks.explanation:
SHE: hawala (reference) half-cell jis ka potential 0.00 V muqarrar hai: 2H⁺(aq) + 2e⁻ ⇌ H₂(g), E° = 0.00 V.
Banawat: 101 kPa (1 atm) par hydrogen gas platinum black chadhi platinum electrode par guzarti hai, jo 1.00 mol dm⁻³ H⁺ ions (misal HCl) ke solution mein doobi hai, 25 °C (298 K) par. Platinum black bareek Pt hai; yeh H₂ aur H⁺ ko qareeb laata hai taake equilibrium jaldi bane; Pt khud reaction nahi karta (inert).
Istemal: naapne wale half-cell (standard halat mein) ko taar aur high-resistance voltmeter ke zariye SHE se, aur salt bridge se jora jata hai. Voltmeter ki reading us half-cell ka E° hai.
Nishan (sign): electrode positive terminal ho to E° positive (Cu²⁺/Cu = +0.34 V; Cu²⁺ reduce hota hai); negative terminal ho to E° negative (Zn²⁺/Zn = −0.76 V; Zn oxidize hota hai).

blocks.prompt:
Q.7 Calculate the electrode potential for a zinc electrode immersed in a 0.010 mol dm⁻³ solution of zinc sulfate (ZnSO₄) at 298 K. The standard electrode potential (E°) for Zn²⁺(aq) + 2e⁻ ⇌ Zn(s) is −0.76 V. (Gas constant, R = 8.31 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹, Faraday constant, F = 96500 C mol⁻¹)
298 K par 0.010 mol dm⁻³ ZnSO₄ mein dooby zinc electrode ka electrode potential nikalein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: [Zn²⁺] = 0.010 mol dm⁻³, T = 298 K, E° = −0.76 V, z = 2, R = 8.31 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹, F = 96500 C mol⁻¹
Maloom karna: E
Nernst equation: E = E° + (2.303RT/zF) log([Zn²⁺]/[Zn]), solid ke liye [Zn] = 1
2.303RT/F = (2.303 × 8.31 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ × 298 K) / 96500 C mol⁻¹ = 0.0591 V
E = −0.76 V + (0.0591 V / 2) × log(0.010)
E = −0.76 V + 0.02955 V × (−2)
E = −0.76 V − 0.059 V
E = −0.82 V
Patla (dilute) solution potential ko E° se zyada negative kar deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q.8 A constant current of 2.00 A is passed through a solution of copper(II) sulfate (CuSO₄) for 30.0 minutes. Calculate the mass of copper deposited at the cathode. (Molar mass of Cu = 63.5 g mol⁻¹, Faraday constant, F = 96500 C mol⁻¹)
2.00 A current 30.0 minute tak CuSO₄ mein guzara gaya. Cathode par kitna copper jamega?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: I = 2.00 A, t = 30.0 min = 1800 s, M(Cu) = 63.5 g mol⁻¹, F = 96500 C mol⁻¹
Maloom karna: Cu ka mass
Cu²⁺(aq) + 2e⁻ → Cu(s): har mol Cu ke liye 2 mol electrons
Q = I × t = 2.00 A × 1800 s = 3600 C
Electrons ke moles = Q / F = 3600 C / 96500 C mol⁻¹ = 0.0373 mol
Cu ke moles = 0.0373 mol / 2 = 0.01865 mol
Cu ka mass = 0.01865 mol × 63.5 g mol⁻¹ = 1.18 g

blocks.prompt:
Q.9 A galvanic cell consists of a standard hydrogen electrode (SHE) and a Ni²⁺(aq)/Ni(s) half-cell. The measured cell potential at 298 K is 0.25 V, and the nickel electrode is the negative terminal.
a) Write the balanced overall cell reaction.
b) Determine the standard electrode potential (E°) of the Ni²⁺(aq)/Ni(s) half-cell.
c) Identify which electrode is the anode and which is the cathode.
SHE aur Ni²⁺/Ni half-cell ke cell ka potential 0.25 V hai aur nickel negative terminal hai. Cell reaction, Ni ka E° aur anode/cathode batayein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: E°cell = 0.25 V (standard halat), Ni negative terminal hai, E°(SHE) = 0.00 V
a) Ni par oxidation: Ni(s) → Ni²⁺(aq) + 2e⁻
SHE par reduction: 2H⁺(aq) + 2e⁻ → H₂(g)
Kul reaction: Ni(s) + 2H⁺(aq) → Ni²⁺(aq) + H₂(g)
b) E°cell = E°(cathode) − E°(anode)
0.25 V = 0.00 V − E°(Ni²⁺/Ni)
E°(Ni²⁺/Ni) = −0.25 V
c) Anode: nickel electrode (negative terminal, oxidation). Cathode: standard hydrogen electrode (positive terminal, reduction).

blocks.title: Wazahat
